name: Aksius no Himekishi
source:
Princess Knight Sedilia leads an army against the invasion of demons, but army gets overpowered. Demon prince gives woman a choice where stakes are too high to ignore.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
骑士公主塞迪莉亚率军抵抗恶魔入侵，但军队被彻底压制。恶魔王子给了她一个代价高昂、无法忽视的选择。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]）
